# Viborg Kirurgi

Viborg Kirurgi is a surgical department whose performance on a key quality indicator for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) treatment has raised concerns. According to data from the Danish IBD quality registry (DANIBD), Viborg Kirurgi recorded a re-operation rate of 12% for surgical procedures, exceeding the development target of 8% [^src1]. 

The re-operation indicator measures surgical quality by tracking the proportion of patients who require repeat surgery within 30 days of their initial procedure. Higher rates suggest either more complex cases or potential gaps in surgical technique or post-operative care. Viborg Kirurgi's 12% rate places it above the national benchmark, identifying it as a department where performance improvement may be warranted [^src1].

This data appears in DANIBD's 2024 annual report, which tracks quality metrics across Danish IBD treatment centers. The report documents both national results and regional or department-level performance, enabling identification of facilities with particularly strong or weak outcomes across key clinical measures [^src1].
